blocks.markdown: [Draft PR 7]([PRIVATE_REFERENCE_REMOVED]) is open, unmerged and verified at `ffc5241a`: bounded native/browser expressions, FP-safe typed persistence and the self-contained verifier, now including the corrected Python guarded-batch codec and pre-transaction request snapshots. The full clean-export verifier and independent correctness/reentry reviews pass; new paired timings and item-2 acceptance remain pending. Accepted item-1 source stays at `e42a8adc`; exact final v1 remains preserved at `fcc3e71f`. [Raw correctness/performance evidence]([PRIVATE_REFERENCE_REMOVED]) and the [selected renewed research decision]([PRIVATE_REFERENCE_REMOVED]) were verified on main before this fix. Original/frozen source and deployed private v1 Site remain unchanged.

**Iteration 1 is accepted within its bounded four-type contract. Iteration 2 is held at its performance gate; iterations 3–10 remain queued in order.** Final normal checks pass 22 legacy, 57 typed and 14 expression binding groups, 262 independent SQL/native cases with recoveries, 13 real expression-store methods, 26 migrations, 472 browser groups and the clean-export verifier/direct-core sanitizers. Categories overlap, not a certification score. Corrected native SQL timing over 42 pairs/12 workloads has median ratios 0.969–1.049×, all 95% intervals including 1; modest regressions remain possible. A separate persisted float-output control shows a real 26–27% median cost (~3.5→4.2–4.4 ms), despite all 480 exact public outcomes. Profiles count 514/515 FP reads per call, supporting a contribution—not exclusive cause. Fresh parallel primary-source research and independent specifications are preserved in [main checkpoint `347aae5e`]([PRIVATE_REFERENCE_REMOVED]). The corrected guarded-batch trial is now published at `ffc5241a`: independent acceptance/review, 115 isolated physical/request children, unchanged FP/legacy suites and the full 267-source clean-export normal/browser/store/direct-sanitizer verifier pass. Public guards, shared per-cell validation/caps and the unchanged FP reader remain; six request fields are copied once before transaction admission, with readiness rechecked after reentry. The first candidate's close/subtype defects were reproduced and retained, then corrected. Post-fix paired timings have not run; item 2 is not accepted until those results are reviewed. Original diagnostic runs, the measured regression and the incomplete large Python-carrier sanitizer transport remain retained, not relabeled passes. [Inspectable coordinator-log snapshot]([PRIVATE_REFERENCE_REMOVED]) is backed up. For item 1, initial isolated timings showed 23–36% losses; 756 CPU-pinned A/B pairs across both load orders and two processes did not reproduce them (paired medians about 0.97–1.03×). Both data sets remain preserved; a large causal ABI regression is not established. The slower compact host-transport proposal was rejected. Production readiness is not claimed.
